sentences.text: Split is a 2016 American psychological horror-thriller film written and directed by M. Night Shyamalan .	M. Night Shyamalan	M. Night Shyamalan	psychological horror	psychological horror	thriller film	thriller film

The film stars James McAvoy , Anya Taylor-Joy , and Betty Buckley , and follows Kevin Wendell Crumb , a man with 23 different personalities who kidnaps and imprisons three teenage girls in an isolated underground facility .	James McAvoy	James McAvoy	Anya Taylor-Joy	Anya Taylor-Joy	Betty Buckley	Betty Buckley	23 different personalities	Dissociative identity disorder
Principal photography began on November 11 , 2015 , in Philadelphia , Pennsylvania .	Principal photography	Principal photography	Philadelphia	Philadelphia	Pennsylvania	Pennsylvania

The film premiered at Fantastic Fest on September 26 , 2016 , and was released in the United States on January 20 , 2017 , by Universal Pictures .	Universal Pictures	Universal Studios	Fantastic Fest	Fantastic Fest

The film received general acclaim , with some critics labeling it a welcoming return for Shyamalan , and was a massive financial success , grossing $ 276 million worldwide on a budget of $ 9 million .
The film is a sequel to the 2000 movie Unbreakable which was also written , produced and directed by M. Night Shaymalan .	Unbreakable	Unbreakable (film)	M. Night Shaymalan	M. Night Shyamalan
A sequel has been confirmed which will be titled Glass .
